common_style: Instagram carousel slide design, 4:5 aspect ratio (1080x1350 px). Trendy magazine editorial style, premium dark. - Background: deep black #0B0B0E with ONE soft warm radial glow (top-right, orange tinted, subtle) and a very subtle film grain texture. - Primary accent: warm orange gradient from #F0956B to #CF5C3F (used for headline keyword, thin progress bar at very top, underline bar). - Primary text: pure white #FFFFFF. - Secondary text: white 45% opacity. - Labels: rounded pill chip with thin orange border, small glowing orange dot, uppercase letter-spaced text. - Signature: huge outlined ghost number in background top-right (outline only, white 7% opacity). - Footer on every slide: small letter-spaced brand text bottom-left, page number bottom-right (current number orange). The exact footer strings are given per slide — render them verbatim and NEVER invent a brand name of your own. - Typography: Korean sans-serif (Pretendard-like), oversized extra-bold headlines with tight letter-spacing, monospace only for code/numbers. - Cards: dark surface with 1px white 9% hairline border, 24px rounded corners. - Layout: generous whitespace, left-aligned, trendy tech magazine feel. - Mood: professional, developer-focused, clean, modern, premium.
